origin: cwe/89/go Key Principles: GORM Order() is listed as a raw-input sink and identifiers require allowlists

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The GORM query parameterizes account_id and status in Where(), but request-controlled sort text flows across handler and service layers into Order().

trap: Declaring the query safe because Where() uses placeholders, wrapping sort in gorm.Expr(), or attempting to bind the ORDER BY column as a value. The sort value must select from a server-side map of allowed GORM order clauses.
must_preserve: The account_id and status filters remain parameterized, the handler still returns 204 on a successful export, and intended sort modes still work without allowing arbitrary SQL text in Order().
